limitations: Manufacturer source STEP retained without scale distortion; component groups use simplified colors. Component identity, connector mating, exact hardware revision correspondence, physical touch and optical pose are not mechanically validated.

Screen position is an approximate registration to the unchanged source front plane; manufacturer active-area and viewing-window dimensions remain distinct. No source photograph containing an app image is overlaid into the guest screen.

Only case 2D engineering drawing is supplied. The enclosure is a dimension-constrained hollow representation with explicit estimated thickness; detailed buttons, connector openings, fastening and fit to bare CAD remain unverified.

Native source includes protruding components down to z=-9.93mm after rigid rotation, a12.70mm maximum assembly range versus10.40mm annotated bare depth. No native geometry is shortened or scaled to conceal this discrepancy; matching the exact installed options and protective-case fit is UNKNOWN.

Case switch apertures and installed button-cap geometry are UNKNOWN; no3D press-through-wall hitbox is invented. BOOT/PWR remain available through the shared2D and agent controls. Native switch solids remain in the preserved CAD reference.

Native semantic components are identified from retained assembly labels and manufacturer control photographs. Source CAD uses simplified material colors; no complete factory color/label reproduction or hardware fit acceptance is asserted.
